character:camille:female_warm.description: A friendly and professional French female voice with a natural, warm tone. Clear articulation and a welcoming presence, perfect for conversational interactions such as Prospection, Client support, Customer service representative, Receptionist.

character:claire:female_professional.description: Professional, responsive, and genuinely human — Cécile handles a support call the way an attentive person would, not a script being read aloud. Her clear, French delivery reacts naturally to what's actually being said, keeping exchanges feeling like real conversations. Built for customer care and helpdesk communication. Ideal for brands that want French-speaking support to feel personally handled.

character:hugo:male_bright.description: A natural and conversational French voice with subtle hesitations and authentic rhythm. Expressive without being exaggerated, lively yet grounded. Perfect for storytelling, podcasts, product demos and human-centered content.

character:inès:female_calm.description:
Warm, gentle young French female voice with a soft, soothing, and natural delivery. Smooth, steady pacing and clear diction. A voice that feels close and comforting, easy to listen to over long-form content. Native standard French Parisien accent, consistent and expressive.

Best use cases: narration and voice-over, audiobooks, explainer and tutorial videos, e-learning, meditation and wellbeing content, corporate presentations

Key qualities: warm, soft, gentle, soothing, clear, natural.

character:julien:male_professional.description: Confident, professional, and engaging, this voice embodies the persona of a young, dynamic real estate agent in Dubai. It carries a warm and friendly tone that immediately puts clients at ease while maintaining a polished and persuasive delivery. The voice is articulate and clear, projecting confidence and expertise, yet approachable enough to foster trust and rapport.

character:léa:female_bright.description: A warm, energetic, natural, authentic, and reassuring French voice.

character:nicolas:male_calm.description: French male voice with a soft, conversational tone. Clear, calm and confident. Ideal for storytelling, explainer videos, corporate videos, and educational content that needs a natural touch.

character:thomas:male_warm.description: A calm, warm and professional French male voice. Natural rhythm, slight tonal variation to show empathy and listening. Clear articulation, no commercial tone, never robotic. Ideal for conversations, appointment booking and gentle explanations.

fr-fr.lexical.native-clear.description: A natural, fluid, and professional AI conversational assistant. Perfect for appointment scheduling, managing customer calls, and providing premium customer service. A clear, human-like, and multilingual voice designed for realistic and effective interactions.
